image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate covered in pink coralline algae and dark encrusting organisms. The chiton displays its characteristic eight overlapping dorsal plates with intricate orange, brown, and cream mottled patterns and textured growth lines. The surrounding girdle is visible, featuring a leathery texture with small orange spots.
